tei:div.tei:p: 227) ༄༅/ kar gling zhi khro chags med lugs ltar 'don pa'i zin chung bzhugs/ 228) ༄༅/

rgyal ba kun 'dus gsung dbang pad+ma'i tshig gsung dbang karma gling pas sgo 'byed pa'i/ gsung dbang karma chags med gsung rgyun ltar/ gsung gi rgyan du gyur phyir zin bsdus bri/ thog mar chos spyod rigs tshar nas/ hriḥ sngon= la/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dril tshag rdeg na mo/ bka' gcog= sngags rnams dril bsil/ tshul khrims dri ldan= sngags la dril dkrol/ gsol 'debs gang rung lhug skyabs yul= lhug thugs rje can la skyabs su= dril bsil/ man chad lhug mtshams su dril bsil re/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis= dril tshag bdag gi bsam pa'i= lhug rang nyid skad cig= dril 'dzin/ sku ru gsal/ 'ur/ sum rdung/ hūm̐: nga nyid lha yi= dal 'don/ mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog= ḍā ru dkrol/ bgegs rdung khug la dgu rdung/ bdag nyid rdor sems lha yi= rnga med/ rang rig rdo rje= nas rnga 'don/ hūm̐ 'phros= ḍā ru dkrol/ 'ur/ sum rdung/ chos nyid skye ba= rdor bser dril bsil/ chos kyi dbyings kyi= da ru dkrol/ mthar 'ur/ sum rdung rkyang pa/ bsam brjod= rnga 'don sngags dril bsil/ gzugs sgra= ḍā ru/ chen po'o: bcad/ rnam par rtogs gsum= mgor dgu gdan sum rdung man rnga 'don/ zhi khro bar/ ( Musical notes and signs here) spyan 'dren mgor/ rol bsu/ 'ur gnyis/ 229) ( Musical notes and signs here) spyan 'dren rnga ru dkrol/ mthar bcad/ hūm̐ hūm̐= ha ha: rnams rnga re re bcad/ dzaḥhūm̐ man rnga 'don/ ( Musical notes and signs here) sgyu ma= ḍā ru dkrol/ mthar bcad/ ( Musical notes and signs here) phyag 'tshal/ mthar/ sum rdung/ srid par= nas/ rol mo la ḍā ru dkrol/ nang gsang gnyis sgra ma mgor/ ḍā ru dkrol/ phyi nang gsang gsum mthar/ ( Musical notes and signs here) 'ur/ mchod rol re/ sman mchod mthar/ sum rdung*/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum= lhug 'don dril bsil re/ gdod ma'i dang bka' brgyud gnyis la bskul mtshams/ lha tshogs= lhug

rigs lnga yab yum= dril tshag rak+ṣa= mthar/ rtsa brgyud bla ma= lha tshogs rnams= gzugs phung= dril tshag gu ru dharmā= dril bsil re/ hūm̐ badz+ra= bskul/ lha tshogs= mthar/ ( Musical notes and signs here) bla ma kun bzang= rnga 'don/ gdod nas= mgor/ ( Musical notes and signs here) gdod nas= tha ma ḍā ru dkrol/ 'ur/ ( Musical notes and signs here) snang srid= rnga 'don/ mthar/ dgu rdung gsum/ bla ma= yig brgya la rnga gnyis/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ shar tshogs grol/ rnga 'ur/ bdag mdun lha tshogs= rang 230)rta/ mthar/ 'ur dgu bcad/ hūm̐ badz+ra= sogs yab yum sbrel sngags gsum re'i mtshams dbu mdzad nas dril bsil re/ ma nu rak+ṣa= dril tshag bho dhi ru lu= brgya / bdag mdun bum lha'i= dzab dgongs/ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya= dril bu ring dkrol can gsum/ oṃ bud+dha= gsum/ swa rat+na= gsum/ hā karmā= gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā badz+ra= brgya'am lnga bcu/ bdag mdun bum pa'i= dzapra rta dril tshag sngags bdun re/ mthar/ 'a a ha sha= nyer gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hāḥ a bh+ya/ཿ gsum/ ma ma ko liṃ= gsum/ 'grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya dril bsil/ ye dhar= badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= nas ḍā ru dkrol/ 'ur/ chos sku nam mkha'= mthar bcad/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i= lhug dge ba= dril tshag med/ las bum/ badz+ra a mṛ= lhug rang bzhin rnam dag= yan dril tshag med/ mtshams rnams dril bsil/ yig brgya nyer gcig dril ring dkrol/ yig drug brgya/ yig brgya gcig bum lha'i sku'i= 'jig rten khams ni= bde gshegs dri med= badz+ra mūḥ ye shes pa= gang bar gyur/ sum rdung*/ sde bdun/ stong pa'i ngang las= spyan 'dren mgor/ 'ur nang*/ rkang*/ ( Musical notes and signs here) spyan 'dren man rnga 'don/ yig brgya mthar/ ( Musical notes and signs here) bstod pa mthar/ bshags pa sbrel/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas zhi ba'i= lhug ma 231)bcos skye med= gnyis bcad/ na moḥdang po'i=

bzhi bcad/ smug nag= bskul lam/ mthar/ zhi ba zhi bcu= lhug dkyil 'khor gtso bo= yig brgya nyer gcig bho dhi ru lu= nyer gcig dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i spyi bor= lhug dril bu ring dkrol gyis hūm̐ badz+ra= gsum/ swa rat+na= gsum/ oṃ pad+ma= gsum/ hā karma= gsum/ oṃ bud+dha= gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā oṃ badz+ra= brgya'am lnga bcu/ du da ha= gsum/ pre pa tsa= gsum/ su ma tha= gsum/ tri sarba= gsum/ a sarba= gsum/ hūṃ ni bhi= gsum/ rigs so so'i= lhug yig drug brgya/ tshe 'das lus kyi= lhug tshig mtha' ma gsum/ bdag ni mi shes= dril tshag med/ de ltar gsol ba= lhug mos pa mdzod/ gang zhig bshags pa= ye shes sku mchog= bzhi bcad dril tshag mthar yig brgya/ gshin chog la 'dir bag chags rang grol/ bar do rtsa tshig gnyis dang*/ bsam lhun/ dro tshogs grol/ ḍā ru bcas/ rol mo 'ur/ sum rdung gi satshogs/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang= ta ya phāṭaḥ sum brdung*/ bdag gi rdo rje= rnga 'don/ me dang rlung dang= nas da ru dkrol/ hrī ha hoḥ 'ur/ sum brdung*/ stong gsum ri rab= dril tshag dang rnga chod/ hūm̐: stong gsum= nas rnga 'don/ stong gsum tha ma nas ḍā ru dkrol/ nyams chag= mthar ḍā ru bcad/ rnga mtshams mi bcad par / kunagazhi= sbrel/ nyams chag= la 232) dril bsil rnga bcad/ chos sku kun tu bzang po= lhug dril bsil re/ spyi btsug bde chen= rnga 'don/ nyams chag= ḍā ru dkraul/ rnga mtshams mi bcad par nar 'gros gtor ma'i mthar/ nyams chag= la ḍā ru dkrol/ mar me'i mthar/ rin chen sna lnga'i= sbyar/ nyams chag= dril bsil/ mthar/ sum rdung*/ dur khrod gsang ba= dril tshags/ mtshams dril bsil/ mthar tshogs spyan 'dren mgor/ rol bsu/ rkang 'ur/ ( Musical notes and signs here)'og min chos dbyings= ḍā ru dkrol/ mthar/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ bla ma kun bzang= rang rta/ yam̐ ram̐ kam̐ las/ rnga 'don/ ḍā ru dkrol/ ( Musical notes and signs here)thugs dam bskang ba'i=

ḍā ru bcas rnga 'don/ ( Musical notes and signs here) bho dhi= lhugadril bsil/ dbus nas= rnga 'don/ bshags/ rnga bcad/ bdag cag 'khor ba'i= rnga 'don/ yig brgya dril bsil/ sum rdung*/ thugs dam bskang bar= rnga 'don/ khyed kyi thugs dam= nas ḍā ru dkrol/ mthar/ 'ur/ rkang*/ sum rdung*/ rnam shes= nas ḍā ru bcas rnga 'don/ nyams chag= la/ rnga chol rgyeb mthar ḍā ru bcad/ man chad rnga 'don/ nyam chag= rigs la ḍā ru bcas rnga chol rgyeb/ kun bzang= mthar/ nyams chag= la dril bsil rnga chol rgyeb sum rdung*/ rang rig= nas ḍā ru/ nyams chag= chol rgyeb sngar ltar/ rnam shes zhe sdang= man rnga 'don/ nyams chag= sngar ltar/ thugs dam bskang ba'i= chol rgyeb/ ḍā ru/ ( Musical notes and signs here) rkyen 233) dbang bzlog: sum rdung*/ snang srid= nyams chag= dril/ ( Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: ma hā ka la= yang cig= ḍā ru/ mthar/ dgu rdung*/ eḥtshogs snod= 'gugs pa gsum/ rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ mi mngon= khug sngags 'ur/ ( Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: khrag 'thung= man sngags 'ur/ dgu gdan/ smyor gzhug mthar/ dgu rdung sngar ltar/ phog par rgyapab cig= rnams: dgu rdung*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas= hī: rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ rnal 'byor pho mo= rol bsu/ 'ur bdun rdung*/ hūm̐: chos dbyings= tshig bzhi tshar nas/ ḍā ru/ mdzod: bdun rdung*/ lhag ma byin rlabs/ bh+yo: dpal gyi= tsho bzhi/ mdzod: ( Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: dngos po= sogs/ ḍā ru/ hoḥ ḍā ru bcad/ 'di ltar= la rnga gcig duḥkha= la rnga gcig lhag ma spyi ltar rdung*/ tshogs 'khor= rgyal ba zhi khro'i= 'od chog 'don/ dwangs chen grol/ mdun bum gnas lnga= sngags gsum/ gnas 'dren/ phyogs bcu na= tshar gsum/ a mṛ ta= las chus bran/ 'gugs pa las phyag rgya mthar dril bsil/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i= rdor sems rgya/ dkon mchog gsum dang= thal sbyar/ sor bsnol lcags kyu/ tshig mtha'/

dril bsil/ shog cig: yig brgya/ nṛ yaṃ= lcags kyu'i rgya lan gnyis/ kye ma dbang med= mthar nas 'thor/ a nṛ k+ṣa: la til me chur lan gsum dor/ tra tha= rnams dbye rgya/ a mṛ ta= las chus bran/ rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas 234) lus la/ rdo rje bskor/ phyi rdo rje'i= bh+yo bi shwa la= zan rkong g.yas bskor gsum g.yon bskor gcig gis las rdor la sprad/ nga nyid= ḍā ru/ sa dang lam la= nas lcags brab/ mtshon cha= ḍā ru/ hūm̐/ ḍā ru bcad/ hūm̐: bdag gi dri ldan= la rnam bum zhabs nas btegs/ khrus dar me long bcas sngags rnams la bzed zhal du khrus bya/ ras 'jam= la me long phyi tshul/ na bza'= la 'bul tshul/ zhi chas khro chas gnyis btegs/ khrus chu las bum du blugs/ 'di ni pha rol= nas lan gsum gyis khrus byed/ 'dod chags zhe sdang= la sgros byab/ sa chu me rlung rnams bskor lugs sngar ltar gyis bzed zhal du dor/ e ma mgon po= gsum/ bla mas/ 'o: sngon tshe= tshe 'phos= nas mnyam 'don/ a mṛ ta= las bum chus gtor/ gtor ma 'dod yon= zan rkong bskor/ las bum gyi khrus bya/ bye ma brab/ kye ma tshe 'das= tshig mtha' lan gsum/ las rdor pas phyag gsum/ rnam bum gyis dbang bskur/ phyag mtshan tsakli g.yung*/ zhal zas 'bul/ sa 'di bcad pa= la dal snga ma dor/ rdo rjes bcad pa rnams rigs drug la 'dra/ e ma= nas/ yongs su bzung: ras bris dkyil 'khor/ shar lho nub byang dbus bcas bgrod tshul/ tsak+ṣu= la mig dar bkab/ pra ti= la me tog dor bcug/ ming btags nas me tog slar spyi bor 'gaud/ mig dbye/ rdo rjes mthong ba bstan/ dbang stegs la 'gaud/ hū?m̐ las= gtso bum/ po ti/ rig lnga'i phyag mtshan/ thun mong rigs lngas dbang bskur/ lha dbang rgyas pa la/ ngo sprod rnams bla mas 'don/ mthar 235) bsdoms te bskur/ rdor sems/ thod chang*/ yab yum/ shel rdo/ me long*/ sna bdun/ rtags brgyad bcas/ 'dod yon la bsang chu gtor/ ting shag brdung*/

sems dpa' lnga'i sku me long la 'char ba bstan/ zas bsngo'i mthar gsur gtong*/ mar me byang bu'i mdun 'gaud/ yon 'bul la dar thag gtso bum zhabs nas drangs ba'i sne nas yar byang bu bgrod tshul/ rlung ro bsal/ bla mas/ byang bu tshe 'das= mda' gzhu la las chus bran/ bla mas/ hoḥ tshe 'das= mda' gzhu'i rgya bca'/ 'di nas nub phyogs= bla mas/ phāṭa: tshe 'das kyi= phāṭa: gsum/ slar yang= mnyam 'don/ mar me la las chus bran/ stong pa nyid kyi= pad+ma 'byung gnas= thal mo sbyar/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po= das bsreg thal ba la gtso bum gyi chus brlan/ sngags byes brab/ bzang spyod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= nas 'thor/ dril bsil/ phyi chog tshar na/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ las byang chung ba'i/ bsam brjod bral ba'i= dgra lha sum rdung*/ rtog bral= 'ur gcig spyan 'dren rnga da nangs dang 'dra/ dpe med= nas/ ḍā ru/ bzhugs gsol mthar bcad/ mchod pa nas dkrol/ rgyas phyir bzhes: 'ur sum rdung*/ rigs lnga= bha lidha khā hi: chos 'byung gi khā hi sbyar/ lha tshogs rnams kyi= ( Musical notes and signs here) sku ni= dgu rdung gsum/ bshags pa/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ ḍā ru 'ur/ zhi ba'i lha tshogs= btags grol/ bho dhi ru lu brgya/ bdag 236) mdun bum lha'i= rigs lnga spyi dril lnga bcu tsam/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= dril bsil/ chos sku nam mkha'= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= na mo/ dang po'i sangs rgyas= sam/ chos rnams rnam dag= zhi ba zhi bcu= spyi gtsug pad zla'i= yig brgya lnga bcu/ tshe 'das lus kyi= bdag ni mi shes= ye shes sku mchog= tshang ma'am/ yang na mgo nas le'u gcig zhi ba gcig khro bo gcig dus gsum bde gshegs= bcas/ tshogs/ rnga 'ur sum rdung*/ nyon cig= hoḥ ( Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: stong gsum= ḍā ru/ sman mchod tshig lhug dor/ nyam chag rnams ḍā ru dkrol/ mar me'i mthar dril bsil mar me'i smon lam mthar/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ tshogs spyan 'dren rnga sngar ltar/

hūm̐: ma bcos= yaṃ bskang gnyis bcas/ bho dhi rnga brdung*/ bdag cag 'khor ba'i= yig brgya/ 'ur sum rdung*/ rnam shes= nas/ nyams chag thams cad rnga 'phar ḍā dril/ thugs dam bskang ba'i= mthar sum rdung*/ snang srid phur= mthar/ tshogs snod= dgu rdung*/ 'gugs pa tshig lhug rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ chos sku zhi ba'i= rgyob so dgu rdung*/ rnal 'byor= pho mo= lhag ma byin brlabs/ rol bsu/ 'ur bdun rdung*/ chos dbyings= nas ḍā ru/ dngos po= sbrel/ hoḥ bcad tshig lhug rnga gnyis/ lhag ma'i rnga da nangs ltar brdung*/ tshogs 'khor phul ba'i= tshigs bcad gnyis/ bshags chung*/ dkar gtor/ gtor snod bhan+dha= dgu rdung*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma= rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ hūm̐: 237) rnam dag chos dbyings= mdzod: ( Musical notes and signs here) bka' dang dam tshig= mthar dgu brdung*/ ma ning nag po= mthar rgyob sod mthar/ ( Musical notes and signs here) dus gsum dus med= ( Musical notes and signs here) shar phyogs sgo ma= mthar/ ( Musical notes and signs here) brtan ma skyong mdzad= brtan ma chen mo= brtan ma'i rnga spyi ltar brdung*/ bro 'gugs snga ma gnyis rgyob sod dgu gdan re/ rjes mar/ sgab mnan sngags gsum/ rgyob sod/ dgu rdung*/ phyogs med= nan: 'ur/ bdag cag= bdag nyid spyi= yig ( Musical notes and signs here) brgya/ a li/ ka li gsum/ kun gzhi ma bcos= gang yang= stong zhing= mi 'gyur lhun po= sku gsum bla ma= gnas 'dir nyin mo= rgyal mtshan= zhi khro= ma mo= sngon tshe= sogs/ nor gyi= sogs/ bstan pa'i= sogs/ ston pa= sogs/ bkra shis sa gzhi= sogs/ bsod nams= sogs/ bgegs rigs= sogs/ lo brgya= sogs/ sbyin pa= sogs/ bdag cag= sogs/ dkyil 'khor= sogs/ 'khor gsum= sogs/ mdun bum gnas lnga= sogs/ 'dir ni= sogs/ gzugs rnams thams cad= sogs/ skad cig stong gsal= sogs/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs/ phyogs dus rgyal ba=

sogs kyis grub po/ rnga chog byed dus 'don lugs de ltar la/ ḍā chog byed na/ las byang che ba'i/ 238) nga nyid= mgor/ 'ur/ mjug tu 'ur/ srung 'khor mthar/ 'ur/ chos nyid skye ba= phyir: bcad/ chos nyid= dkrol/ mthar 'ur/ bsam brjod= dkrol/ gyur: bcad/ gzugs sgra= dkrol/ chen po'o: bcad/ phyi snod= dkrol/ dpe med= mgor/ 'ur/ gsol: bcad/ sgyu ma= dkrol/ mthar/ bcad/ mchod pa rol mo nas dkrol/ phyi nang gsang gsum la 'ur gsum/ stsol: bcad/ gtor ma'i 'dod gsol mthar 'ur/ bla ma kun bzang= dkrol/ gdod nas= mgor bcad tha ma dkrol/ mthar 'ur/ bshags pa mgor bcad/ dzapra rnga chog ltar/ sde bdun/ shar du srog grub= dkrol/ spyan 'dren mgor/ 'ur/ yig brgya'i mgor bcad/ bstod par/ dkrol/ mthar/ 'ur/ sum bcad/ tshogs mgor/ 'ur/ phaṭaḥ bcad/ stong gsum ri rab= nam mkhas= mgo nas dkrol/ 'ur/ nyams chag= mthar/ bcad/ raka gtor gnyis kyi/ nyams chag= la dkrol bcad/ bya stsol/ dkrol/ 'ur/ tshogs spyan 'dren/ 'ur/ yaṃ bskang gnyis mthar bcad/ khyed kyi thugs dam= nas/ dkrol/ 'ur/ rnam shes= dkrol lugs rnga chog dus ltar ram/ yang na zhi ba dkrol/ thugs dam bskang ba'i= dkrol/ sde skong*/ yang cig= dkrol/ bcad/ 'gugs pa rjes ma dkrol/ mi mngon= le tshan gcig dkrol bcad/ dang po'i sangs rgyas= dkrol/ 'ur sum bcad/ lhag ma mgor/ 'ur dkrol/ bcad/ lhag ma byin rlabs/ yang dkrol/ dngos po'i= mthar/ 'ur/ dgu bcad/ tshogs 'khor= sogs/ 239) phyi chog rnga 'ur/ bsam brjod= nas dkrol/ gyur: bcad/ dkyil 'khor mu ran= dkrol/ bzhugs gsol mthar bcad/ mchod pa dkrol/ bzhes: 'ur/ dkrol/ stsolaḥ bcad/ lha tshogs= 'ur/ bstod: bcad/ tshogs mgo 'ur/ phaṭaḥ bcad/ skong ba 'don na/ stong gsum= rnam dkrol/ mar me'i smon lam mthar/ 'ur/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa/ yaṃ bskang mthar bcad/ yig brgya/ 'ur/ rnam shes= dkrol lugs res mos/ tshogs 'gugs mthar/ 'ur/ bsgral bstab/ dkrol/

'ur/ sum bcad/ lhag ma/ 'ur/ dkrol/ 'ur dgu bcad/ rtsa brgyud= ma'i/ bdag mdun thugs las= nas dkrol/ 'ur/ rnam dag= tshig bzhi/ dkrol bcad/ mtha' mar/ dkrol bcad/ sprul pa yang sprul= dkrol can/ skyes bu dam can= dkrol 'ur/ dus gsum dus med= lhu gcig dkrol bcan/ rang rang srog gi= 'gregs thams cad la dkrol bcad/ phyogs bzhi= dkrol bcad/ bod khams= dkrol 'ur/ sum bcad/ 'gugs pa gsum mthar/ 'ur/ dkrol/ 'ur/ dgu bcad de sngar ltar ro// dge'o//
